claim: Nonvanishing and Q-linear independence of the four actual global completed-character invariant differential pullbacks
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
index_scope: All i:Fin 4 for the actual fixed SourceTwistArithmetic318.units. The etale frame and complementary-root helper retain arbitrary rational twist units.
external_input_scope: No new literature input; actual existing algebraic maps and pinned Mathlib universal-differential, finite-etale, field and finite-sum APIs only.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: An actual nonzero dt frame and independent complementary root characters.
obligations.constructed: The entire unbranched order is finite etale over the localization of Q[t]; the specified original Raw field and actual root-sign algebra automorphisms are retained.
obligations.why_match: The frame is built by two formally etale differential equivalences and sends the actual dt to one. The character separation proof applies each genuine field automorphism and adds its equation to the original relation; characteristic zero supplies cancellation of two.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: The same four global intrinsic forms already obtained from the completed-character Scheme maps.
obligations.constructed: The conclusions name ContactCharacterDifferentials318.differential i for each i:Fin 4, with no new choice of forms.
obligations.why_match: Their finite restrictions are precisely ContactCharacterAffinePullback318.finiteForm i by the immutable predecessor. Both nonvanishing and independence pull an assumed global equality back through this exact affine section equivalence.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: All four complementary characters and their complete global sections.
obligations.constructed: Every i:Fin 4 and every rational coefficient function a:Fin 4 -> Q are quantified. The root independence helper works for arbitrary rational twist units c.
obligations.why_match: No sample or three-of-four character test is used. Each sign fixes its own complementary root and negates every other complementary root.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Transport actual forms and coordinates from the whole finite chart to the entire unbranched order and original field.
obligations.constructed: toOpen wraps the existing orderToOpen, frame is the actual dt frame, and rawValue uses the existing openEmbedding into Raw. embedding_z is proved from the original cubic embedding and source integral-closure lift compatibility.
obligations.why_match: No abstract replacement fraction field or arbitrary basis is selected. The normalized coefficient belongs to the same Raw field whose root-sign automorphisms are applied.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: An independence theorem for actual globally pulled invariant sections, not only formal character labels.
obligations.constructed: The whole-affine section equivalence identifies the actual finiteForm with each global restriction; its injectivity turns a restricted global relation into the precise affine relation.
obligations.why_match: A hypothetical global dependence produces a relation among the exact embedded frame coefficients, so their independent roots force those same global coefficients to vanish. No converse extension from a generic section is invoked.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: Q-linear independence for the actual Q-structure map, retaining every published coordinate scale.
obligations.constructed: Global constants are defined by the literal structureMap.appTop and GammaSpecIso. In Raw the coefficient of finiteForm_i is (scaleUnit_i/2)/root_i.
obligations.why_match: The scaleUnit is a rational unit. All rational scalar maps are matched by RingHom.ext_rat or map_rat_algebraMap. The generic root lemma also proves RatFunc(Q)-independence but no integral lattice assertion is made.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: Do not mistake an equality on a generic field for construction or regularity of global forms.
obligations.constructed: The forms were constructed globally in the accepted predecessor; the new whole unbranched chart is used only to detect nonzero and reject relations.
obligations.why_match: A global zero restricts to zero. The new proof does not assert equality or gluing from generic agreement, and makes no additional infinity-regularity inference.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: Justify every cancellation and protect all allowed twists and indices.
obligations.constructed: Two is nonzero in characteristic zero, each complementary root is nonzero in the original Kummer field, and every scaleUnit is an actual rational unit.
obligations.why_match: The denominator-free finite normalization is consumed before passing to Raw. Root inverses occur only in the field. The source dt cannot vanish because its image in the entire etale order has frame value one.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: Supply nonvanishing and rational independence as a concrete differential-correspondence input.
obligations.constructed: Four actual global intrinsic one-forms are proved nonzero and rationally independent with their exact completed-character origins.
obligations.why_match: This establishes a four-dimensional independent family only. It does not identify the entire space of global forms, a Jacobian, an isogeny or polarization, a PEL/Shimura object, Kodaira-Spencer, or a metric/height formula. Actual root-sign automorphisms are not called inertia.

not_claimed: basis or dimension of all global intrinsic one-forms
PEL/Shimura identification or selection of twists from a moduli source
validation: All six source bodies passed bounded strict checks. Fresh target-only recursive axiom/endpoint audit passed 134 declarations in six modules using only standard roots. No full-chain replay; hosted combined integration remains separate.
